description: Helmond Castle sits in its city moat: a square brick water castle with a round tower at each corner, each capped by a slate spire. The north side is a gatehouse with two square towers and a stepped gable over the gate, reached by a stone bridge. The sky is clear, about 13.9°C, with wind near 8.6 km/h. The park is empty.
